'''October 2000 Folsom tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Folsom, CA on 15 October 2000. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1361">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-18-folsom-ca-10-15d1361/ folsom-ca-10-15], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 18 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-18-folsom-ca-10-15d1361/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Folsom, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
